name: initGame
source:
if (this.initializing || this.gameState) return;
        const sessionId = String(this.gameSessionId || this.roomId || '');
        if (!sessionId || sessionId !== String(this.roomId || '')
            || this.roomExpectedHostId !== this.playerId) {
            this.traceMultiplayerLifecycle('gameSessionCreated', {
                functionName: 'initGame', reason: 'rejected_non_authoritative_or_mismatched_session',
                gameSessionId: sessionId, roomId: this.roomId,
                expectedHostId: this.roomExpectedHostId || null
            }, true);
            return;
        }
        this.initializing = true;
        const deck = this.createConfiguredDeck(this.gameState?.jokerCount ?? this.jokerCount, this.gameState?.jokerUp ?? this.jokerUp, this.gameState?.aceUp ?? this.aceUp);
        const zero = { galleon: 0, anchor: 0, nextMarker: 'galleon' };
        const gameId = id();
        const initialState = {
            gameSessionId: sessionId,
            roomId: sessionId,
            phase: 'boarding',
            crewSize: 2,
            hostId: this.playerId,
            boardingCreatedAt: Date.now(),
            voyageStartedAt: null,
            voyageStatus: 'boarding',
            level: this.normalizeLevel(this.level),
            jokerCount: this.level === 2 ? this.normalizeJokerCount(this.jokerCount) : 2,
            jokerUp: this.level === 2 && Boolean(this.jokerUp) && !this.aceUp,
            aceUp: this.level === 2 && Boolean(this.aceUp),
            inflation: this.level === 2 && Boolean(this.inflation),
            threeElevens: this.level === 2 && Boolean(this.threeElevens),
            bootyEnabled: this.level === 2 && Boolean(this.bootyEnabled) && !this.bootyInfiniteEnabled,
            bootyInfiniteEnabled: this.level === 2 && Boolean(this.bootyInfiniteEnabled),
            extensionMode: false,
            extensionCount: 0,
            winningTarget: WIN_SCORE,
            anchorMaxScore: ANCHOR_MAX_SCORE,
            pendingBootyOffer: null,
            pendingBootyExtension: null,
            bootyAwardDisplay: null,
            bootyGeneratorSide: null,
            stalemateRule: this.level === 2,
            jokerSacrifice: this.level === 2,
            deck,
            p1Hand: [],
            p2Hand: [],
            p1Score: zero,
            p2Score: { ...zero },
            p1VoyageBest: { points: 0, label: 'No score yet' },
            p2VoyageBest: { points: 0, label: 'No score yet' },
            crib: [],
            cribOwners: {},
            p1CribCards: [],
            p2CribCards: [],
            upCard: null,
            dealer: null,
            turn: null,
            cutRound: 1,
            roundNumber: 1,
            p1CutCardId: null,
            p2CutCardId: null,
            cutJokerSide: null,
            cutWinner: null,
            cutWinnerCard: null,
            cutNotice: '',
            goal: WIN_SCORE,
            peggingStack: [],
            peggingHistory: [],
            completedPeggingHistory: [],
            peggingTotal: 0,
            peggingRound: 0,
            peggingGoRecords: { p1: [], p2: [] },
            peggingValueConstraints: {},
            upCardChoices: {},
            upCardChoiceLocks: {},
            passed: { p1: false, p2: false },
            lastPlayer: null,
            p1OriginalHand: null,
            p2OriginalHand: null,
            p1Claimed: false,
            p2Claimed: false,
            p1CountHandReady: false,
            p2CountHandReady: false,
            handScoringStarted: false,
            handCountStage: 'waiting_for_readiness',
            cribClaimed: false,
            cribRevealed: false,
            p1CribSubmitted: false,
            p2CribSubmitted: false,
            p1NextRoundReady: false,
            p2NextRoundReady: false,
            p1NewRoundReady: false,
            p2NewRoundReady: false,
            countTurn: null,
            declarations: {},
            declarationLocks: {},
            sacrificedJokers: {},
            countAnimation: null, stalemateEvent: null, sacrificePrompt: null,
            gameOver: false,
            winnerPlayerId: null,
            victoryEventId: null,
            finalScores: null,
            gameTally: { p1: 0, p2: 0 },
            wicketAwarded: false,
            wicketWinner: null,
            wicketEvent: null,
            winnerTallyApplied: false,
            peggingCompleteAt: null,
            peggingEndReason: null,
            eventLog: []
        };
        this.traceMultiplayerLifecycle('gameSessionCreated', {
            functionName: 'initGame', reason: 'authoritative_host_created_initial_game_state',
            gameSessionId: sessionId, stateId: gameId, hostId: this.playerId
        }, true);
        const persisted = this.safeSync('game initialization', () => this.persistAndBroadcastGameState({ id: gameId, ...initialState }, null, ''));
        persisted.then((ok) => {
            if (ok && this.gameSessionId === sessionId && this.roomId === sessionId) {
                this.gameState = { id: gameId, ...initialState };
                this.initializing = false;
                this.traceMultiplayerLifecycle('gameSessionCreated', {
                    functionName: 'initGame', reason: 'initial_state_persisted',
                    gameSessionId: sessionId, stateId: gameId, hostId: this.playerId
                });
                this.saveCurrentGameResume();
                this.render();
                this.validateGameSessionMembership('initial_game_state_persisted');
                this.confirmPrivateRoomHandoff('captain_initial_room_state_persisted');
            } else {
                this.initializing = false;
                if (!ok) this.traceMultiplayerLifecycle('gameSessionCreated', {
                    functionName: 'initGame', reason: 'initial_state_persistence_failed',
                    gameSessionId: sessionId, stateId: gameId
                }, true);
            }
        });
    }
